exposure: Congenital bone marrow failure syndrome (Pearson marrow-pancreas syndrome)
cohort: A 15-month-old male child with a known congenital bone marrow failure syndrome.
finding: A large heteroplasmic 4,977 bp mitochondrial deletion, suggestive of Pearson marrow-pancreas syndrome, was identified in a child who presented with lactic acidosis and ultimately succumbed to multi-organ failure.
followup_time: 16 months after birth (15 months at presentation + within a month of hospital admission)
